notes.title: Hypnosis Prison is on sell!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is Mr.H, and after a two-year hiatus, the game is finally complete! First, I want to apologize for the delay, as my full-time job unexpectedly became too demanding, making it impossible to finish the game on time. Eventually, I made the tough decision to resign and focus on accelerating the progress, and fortunately, I caught up.
This game is based on another idol I really like, incorporating elements of gambling, hypnosis, and a touch of the grind of office life and the relief of watching live broadcasts. I hope you all can enjoy the game when playing.
On 11/29, it's the anniversary of that idol. If you have the chance, let’s watch together!
After confirming there are no bugs or errors, I need to quickly move on to job interviews. To bring out the next game, I need to work harder; Next game will be Business teetee! I've already written numerous plot segments, but every time I watch  live, new inspiration pops up. I really hope to finish it soon!
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions while playing Hypnosis Prison, feel free to leave a comment in the Steam. I had considered managing other community platforms, but it's just too busy, and I want to allocate my limited time to game development. Later on, there will be combo packs available, allowing everyone to get both Golden Axe Idol and Hypnosis Prison simultaneously.
If you've played Hypnosis Prison and also Golden Axe Idol, don't forget to try out the newly released free game!Golden Axe Idol - Escape The Room! It is an independent follow-up story.
